$(l)Spell Overload$()

By default, spells execute one leaf node per tick (one rune sequence in normal node, one frame of countdown in wait node, one iteration in loop node, etc.). $(9)Spell Overload$() allows you to run spells at accelerated speed.

Overload multiplier is tied to your $(l)Mana Level$():
·Mana Level < 10: Max multiplier $(9)1x$()
·Mana Level ≥ 10: Max multiplier = $(9)2 + 2×(Mana Level - 10) / 5$()

When Mana Level ≥ 10 and not in overload state, use up/down arrow keys to adjust multiplier, press M to toggle spell overload.

You can also set an individual overload multiplier for spells in your spell library. Setting an overload multiplier n greater than 1 makes the spell run at $(9)n times$() speed, capped at your overload limit; setting it to $(9)0$() makes the spell run at 1x speed — it will not multiply even if you have overload enabled; setting it to $(9)1$() makes the spell follow your overload multiplier, which is also the default. A spell with an overload multiplier set also takes effect when copy-pasted onto a SpellStick or Scroll, or added to a Magic Star's spell list.

$(l)Elemental Reaction Quick Reference$()

$(9)Electrocute$(): Lightning + Water → Lightning damage +50%
$(9)Conduction$(): Water + Lightning → Instant 10 magic damage
$(9)Overload$(): Lightning + Fire / Fire + Lightning → Explosion without block damage
$(9)Freeze$(): Ice + Water / Water + Ice → Stun for seconds (continuous freezing causes resistance accumulation, reducing freeze time)
$(9)Neutralize$(): Fire + Water / Water + Fire → Water/Fire damage -30%
$(9)Cancel$(): Fire + Ice / Ice + Fire → Ice/Fire damage -30%
$(9)Combust$(): Fire + Wind → Fire damage +30%, ignites target
$(9)Spread(Fire)$(): Wind + Fire → 3-block range fire damage with fire attachment

$(9)Spread(Ice)$(): Wind + Ice → 3-block range ice damage with ice attachment
$(9)Spread(Water)$(): Wind + Water / Water + Wind → 3-block range water damage with water attachment
$(9)Cold Wind$(): Ice + Wind → Ice damage +30%
$(9)Void Erosion$(): End + Water / Water + End → 10 void damage

$(l)Tip:$()Environment also applies elements — Water in rain/water, Fire in Nether, Ice in snow biomes. Some mob attacks also carry elements.

$(l)SpellTermination$()

You may encounter situations where you need to end a spell early. In that case, simply press the default $(9)I$() key to terminate all spells under your control.
